**صدقة جارية — Sadaqa Jariyah on behalf of Mohamad Koussa and Dima Ghannoum and their families.**

Mus'haf: the Madani mushaf with verse-by-verse recitation (26 reciters), translations, tafsir, notes, bookmarks and search, in Arabic, English and French — for **Android (phones, tablets, foldables and TV), iPhone and iPad, Windows and macOS**. The same app as Quran Reader HD 1.3.

### New in {{VERSION}}
- **A new app icon** on every platform: «القرآن» in gold calligraphy over an open mushaf, with a crescent and stars, in a gold frame on deep green. Also on the Android TV banner and the website.

### In 1.10.11
- **Friday reminder: Surat Al-Kahf.** Every Friday (9:00 by default) a notification reminds you to read Surat Al-Kahf, with the hadith «مَن قرأ سورة الكهف في يوم الجمعة أضاء له من النور ما بين الجمعتين». It arrives even when the app is closed, and tapping it opens Al-Kahf. The first time you open the reader, your phone, iPad or Mac asks whether Mus'haf may send notifications; **Settings ▸ Reminders** turns it off or changes the time. On every platform: Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows and macOS.
- **Colours by subject.** The new palette button in the title bar colours each passage of the mushaf by its subject or story — the Quran's 556 classical ruku' sections, one soft colour each — and shows above the page which surah and ayahs each colour covers. The button works with the TV remote too, and the app remembers your choice.

### In 1.10.10
- **The same dark green menus and bars on every device.** Android phones in light mode showed pale menus and title bars while the TV, iPhone and phones in dark mode showed dark green ones; now all of them use the dark green look. The mushaf page still follows your device's light or dark setting (Classic paper stays white in light mode; Night is always dark).

### In 1.10.9
- Fixes the "Null check operator used on a null value" message that flashed when switching the language on the opening page (and when switching between light and dark), introduced in 1.10.8.

### In 1.10.8
- **Android TV: the Translation & Tafsir view's options work with the remote.** Up from the top of the list, or from a surah's first ayah, reaches *Arabic · Translation · Both* and *Tafsir* (on the one in use); left and right move along them, OK picks one, and down goes back to the list, still on your ayah. The focused option is filled so it shows from across the room.
- **Android TV: the update notice works with the remote.** Up from the page reaches its **Download** button (left for *Later* and *Skip This Version*); up again is the title bar.
- In the translation and tafsir panel, left and right stay among its tabs and buttons.
- The macOS and iPhone builds use more widely available build machines, so they are back in the release.

### In 1.10.7
- **Android TV: the translation and tafsir panel keeps the remote.** However it opens (an ayah's menu or the title bar), up and down read its text, left and right go to the next and previous ayah, up from the top reaches its tabs and source list, and Back closes it. The page behind no longer changes while it is open.
- **The Translation & Tafsir view reads with the remote**: up and down scroll the list (the mushaf's pages don't turn behind it), left and right go to the next and previous surah, OK selects the ayah at the top, then up and down go ayah by ayah, reading to the end of a long one first; the selected ayah is outlined.
- The translation view shows the right surah when it starts part-way down a page.

### In 1.10.6
- **Android TV: everything with the remote.** The side menu opens on its tabs, and the arrows move along them (Surahs, Juz', Search, Bookmarks, Notes) and down their lists. Search fields no longer trap the remote: up and down pass through them, and the TV keyboard opens only when you press OK. Choosing Translation or Tafsir from an ayah's menu takes you into it: down and up scroll the text, left and right go to the next and previous ayah, up from the top reaches the source list to pick another tafsir or translation, and Back returns to the page. Menus and dialogs open on their first item; Settings and the recitation options (reciter, repeat) work with the remote; Continue Reading no longer stops up and down from reaching the title bar and the player.
- **The Sadaqa Jariyah opening page fits every screen**, with no scrolling: two columns on landscape screens (phones turned sideways, tablets, TVs, desktop windows), smaller on the smallest phones and larger on tablets. On the Mac it scales down when the window is short.

### In 1.10.5
- **Android TV: the remote control reaches everything.** On the page, left and right turn pages, up goes to the title bar and down to the player; left and right then move between their buttons, and down or up return to the page. **OK** selects the first ayah: up and down move ayah by ayah (on to the next page), OK opens the ayah's menu (play, translation, tafsir, note, share…), and **Back** leaves it. In full screen, up or down shows the controls. Play/pause and next/previous media keys work too, and the focused button has a clear outline.
- The same keys work with a keyboard on Windows and with a keyboard or game controller on tablets.

### In 1.10.4
- **Bigger pages on tablets and large screens.** With the side menu showing (wide screens such as a 12" tablet in landscape), the page slider and player move to the foot of the side menu, so the pages use the full height. On other tablets and in desktop windows the player takes one row instead of two.

### In 1.10.3
- **Android**: the app draws behind the status and navigation bars on every Android version, as on Android 15 and later, with the page and controls kept clear of them.

### In 1.10.2
- **Mus'haf for iPhone and iPad**: the same app as on Android, in everything — full screen, continue reading, 26 reciters with Salah Bukhatir ★, memorisation repeat, the Coloured mushaf and ribbon bookmarks, notes, the full index, translations and tafsir. Bookmarks, last page, language and reciter from the earlier iPhone app carry over.
- iPhone & iPad download in **Settings ▸ Download Mus'haf** on every platform.

### In 1.10.1
- **Salah Bukhatir is the default reciter**, marked with a ★. A reciter you already chose stays selected.
- **Download Mus'haf** in Settings: the newest Android, Windows, macOS and iPhone builds, Google Play and the web reader.

### Since 1.10
- **Full-screen reading** (Android, TV and Windows): tap the page for the controls; they hide again by themselves. Back or Esc leaves full screen (F11 on Windows).
- **Continue where you stopped**: *Continue Reading*, *Continue Listening* or *Start from the Beginning* on the opening page.
- **Mus'haf for Windows and macOS**.

### Install
**Android** (Android 7 or later) — download **Mushaf-{{VERSION}}.apk** on the phone and open it; allow your browser or Files app to install apps when Android asks. It updates the Mushaf app already installed. Google Play users get the update from Play.

**Windows** (Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit) — download **Mushaf-{{VERSION}}-Setup.exe** and run it. It installs for your user only, so no administrator rights are needed. If SmartScreen warns that the app is unrecognised, choose **More info → Run anyway**. Or unzip **Mushaf-{{VERSION}}-Windows-Portable.zip** anywhere and run `Mushaf.exe`.

**macOS** (macOS 26 or later) — download **Mushaf-{{VERSION}}.dmg**, open it and drag *Mus'haf* into Applications. The app isn't signed with an Apple Developer ID yet, so the first time, right-click the app, choose **Open**, then confirm.

**iPhone and iPad** (iOS 15 or later) — **Mushaf-{{VERSION}}-iOS.ipa** isn't signed: install it with **SideStore** or **AltStore**, which sign it with your own Apple ID (a free one works; the app then needs a refresh every 7 days), or with Xcode. Step by step: https://www.mushafapp.com/iphone.html
